verdicts.evidence: All 12 cited locations (TestHarness.jl:85, Witnesses.jl:93, Reflection.jl:311, Scan.jl:268, Config.jl:250, Sync.jl:560, Rounds.jl:223, Preflight.jl:185, Bump.jl:12, Release.jl:7, Gate.jl:8, Seed.jl:41) now use the bulleted 'The arguments are:' list. src/Scans/args_form.jl:7 now defines `const ARGS_BULLET = r"The\s+arguments\s+are:"` (whitespace/newline tolerant) with a comment noting the marker line-wraps; Scan.jl:231-232 and Preflight.jl:320-321 still wrap 'The\narguments are:' but \s+ spans the newline, so both are correctly detected as bulleted.

args_form.jl:19-34 now finds the FIRST '(' and walks paren depth to its matching close, rather than `findlast(')')`. Traced on argcov's exact signature 'argcov(cfg; exempt = (hit -> false)) -> (hits, population, skipped)': inside resolves to 'cfg; exempt = (hit -> false)' — 1 pos, 1 kw, return tuple excluded.

src/CLI/Preflight.jl:203-205: "`needs` holds the requirement tags (`html`, `git`, `rulebook`) `not_applicable` is computed from, and `not_applicable` says the substrate cannot exist here..." — needs is now explained alongside the other fields.

src/Scans/code_in_math.jl:1-3 header comment now reads "braced subscripts and superscripts of any length", matching the `[a-z]+` (one-or-more) quantifier in the regexes at line ~178. The old 'one-letter subscripts' wording is gone; grep for 'one-letter' in the file returns nothing.
